tau: the region calibration in force: rule sc1-box-gate/3, gate report reports/sc1/box-gate-3.json SHA-256 f639b5bc41b12388ab430e9e86fda78143bb2984ae483d83cd65e3916d1ff0d5
measure: offset = (mean of the present S, N, Po, Ar, Or − the cranial-base box centre) / its longer side, x mirrored on a left-facing film; at least 3 points
judged: the check judges a tracing only when all five of S, N, Po, Ar, Or are present; with any missing the centre look reads too-few and never flags (the median and line are set on complete expert tracings, and a missing point moves the tracing pin). Every calibration tracing is complete (checked before the run) and is read as stored, facing right
line: largest |offset − median| rounded up to 0.01, never below 0.02
control: the cranial base moved 20 mm along +x on every calibration film with a scale: flagged on at least 95% (20 × flagged ≥ 19 × films)
scales: Ceph-400 Train and Test1 at 0.1 mm/px (300 films); the hold-out and Aariz valid under aariz-scale/1 (Aariz valid: 98 films; the hold-out's count printed); a film without a scale is not moved; each count printed
separation: information, and a stop: the cranial base moved 10 mm along +x on the same films with a scale, flagged count per set and in all; stated as in-sample (the line is set on these same films, the development films among them); stop (exit 4) when at most half are flagged in all (2 × flagged ≤ films): the centre look then cannot tell a 10 mm move from normal
counts: C7: 70 + 150 + 150 + 150 = 520 films, each set's count as stated
writes: models/regions/cb-centre-calibration.json (git-ignored) with the report's SHA-256; reports/sc1/cb-centre-calibration.json

verdicts.pass: the 20 mm control holds, the 10 mm separation holds, line at most 0.10 -> exit 0
verdicts.stop: line above 0.10, the 20 mm control under 95%, or the 10 mm move flagged on at most half -> exit 4, to the owner
verdicts.broken: a count off, a refusal failed, a pin differs -> exit 1
